description: This file defines the ImagesDatasource class, which manages image resource data for an Angular application, including loading, selection, and pagination functionalities.

classes.name: ImagesDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for managing image resources, supporting loading, selection, and pagination.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Returns an observable of the current list of image resources for display.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Completes the data streams when the data source is disconnected.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the data source to an empty state.

methods.name: loadEntities
methods.description: Loads image entities from the server with pagination and filtering options.

methods.name: fetchEntities
methods.description: Fetches image data from the ImageService based on provided parameters.

methods.name: isAllSelected
methods.description: Checks if all entities are selected.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the data source has no entities.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns the total number of image entities.

methods.name: masterToggle
methods.description: Selects or clears all entities based on current selection.
